hotels.title: Comfortable Kuta Stay with Onsite Bar & Restaurant
hotels.description: Step into the heart of Kuta with a stay at this comfortable retreat, with the lively energy of Kuta Beach and Waterbon Bali's thrilling slides nearby. Whether it's for business or leisure, ibis Bali Kuta provides the perfect accommodation for a relaxing stay. After exploring the bustling local markets or catching a sunset at the beach, recharge with international and Indonesian favourites at Rendez-Vous or enjoy a casual drink at the onsite bar.

hotels.title: Stylish Kuta Beachfront Escape with Sparkling Infinity Pool, Rooftop Restaurant & Bar
hotels.description: Soak up the sun-drenched allure of Bali's popular Kuta Beach from this design-forward luxury stay, overlooking the shimmering waters of the Indian Ocean. Blending effortless Balinese charm with a social club-inspired atmosphere, the hotel's chic interiors, plush rooms and lavish amenities ensure an unforgettable escape, mere steps from Kuta's golden sands. Spend your days indulging in Kuta's iconic sun, surf and sand, explore colourful markets and sample street food at nearby warungs. Return to your hotel's rooftop to enjoy a refreshing dip in the infinity pool and catch epic beach sunsets, all while savouring laidback bites and sipping on well-crafted cocktails at Afterglow Bar & Kitchen.
